findings.summary: The GitHub request page size and pagination termination share a duplicated numeric value that must be kept synchronized.

assessment.reason: The same pagination contract is encoded in both the URL query and batch-length condition. Naming the value once removes the need to coordinate those two locations without changing the current request behavior.
evidence: assets/script.js: fetchRepos uses a literal per_page=100 in the request and batch.length === 100 in the stop condition.
test/script.test.cjs: loads every repository once in updated order using API pagination verifies the requested page size, complete ordered list, card count, and page sequence.
assessment.invariant: Keep the exact GitHub request parameters and request order, 100-item page size, all-repository result order, filter and link behavior, and complete error-state behavior unchanged.

findings.summary: The Known Traps section incorrectly states that current tests stub theme APIs without asserting theme behavior.

assessment.reason: The outdated statement can mislead future maintainers into treating existing theme coverage as absent. Removing only that false clause restores factual accuracy while retaining the actual system-theme limitation.
evidence: AGENTS.md: Known Traps contains the sentence 'Current tests stub theme APIs rather than asserting theme behavior.'
test/script.test.cjs: four initialization scenarios assert theme selection, and persists theme toggles and restores the choice on reload asserts click behavior, storage writes, and restoration.
The most recent accepted test run executed all 18 component cases successfully; test and production script bytes are unchanged at this scan source.
assessment.invariant: Preserve the documented one-time system preference behavior and every other instruction, configuration declaration, rule pointer, review-marker value, and site behavior; remove only the obsolete test-coverage sentence.
